header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: transgression there is an evil place of return — (that is) Jahannam, which they will enter — and (it) is a most evil resting place. This (is for the wicked) — so let them taste it — (it is) scalding boiling water and pus; and there are also many other (punishments) of the same kind.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (اِنْطَلِقُوآ إِلَي مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ ۞ إِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَي ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلثِ شُعَبٍ ۞ لَّاظَلِيلٍ وَّلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ ۞ إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ ۞ كَأَنَّهُ جِملَتٌ صُفْرٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Walk on to that which you used to deny (it will be said); walk on to a shade (of smoke) having three branches. (It) gives no (pleasant) shade, nor does it protect from the heat of the fire. Indeed it throws up sparks like (huge) palaces; indeed it (the spark) is like yellow camels.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (لَهُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ؕ ذلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ ؕ يعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: For them there will be layers of fire above them, and (similar”) layers beneath them; that is (because) “Allah frightens His servants with it”; so, O My servants! Fear Me alone.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (إِنَّ شَجَرََتَ الزَّقُّومِ ۞ طَعَامُ اْلاَثِيمِ ۞ كَالْمُهْلِ ۚ يَغْلِي
